headline: This law names a New York City post office building after Normandia Maldonado.
what_it_does: It officially designates the U.S. Postal Service facility at 511 West 165th Street in New York, New York, as the Normandia Maldonado Post Office Building. The change is symbolic and honors the person for whom the building is named. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 21, 2020.
